task_confidence: Initial keyword-based suggestion; requires user confirmation
recommendation: Confirm the problem type and intended output before selecting algorithms.
clarifying_questions: Who will use the system and what will they do with its output?
How will success be measured, and what level of error is acceptable?
Are there constraints on budget, privacy, hardware, data volume, or tools?

future_scope.name: Clarify requirements
future_scope.deliverable: Approved project brief and success criteria

future_scope.name: Assess datasets
future_scope.deliverable: Data quality, suitability, source and licence review

future_scope.name: Package delivery
future_scope.deliverable: Model artifact, inference code, report and setup guide

data_policy: Validate actual dataset contents before making suitability claims.
Record source and licence for externally obtained datasets.
Clearly label synthetic data and never describe it as real-world data.
Compare dataset quality separately from model performance.
Use held-out data or cross-validation to reduce evaluation leakage.
